data.name: Cow
data.spawnConditions: Spawns on grass blocks with light level 9+, in groups of 4.
data.behavior: Wanders aimlessly, avoids cliffs and water. Can be milked with a bucket. Follows players holding wheat.
data.notes: One of the most useful passive mobs for early game food and leather armor.

data.name: Sheep
data.spawnConditions: Spawns on grass blocks with light level 9+, in groups of 4.
data.behavior: Wanders aimlessly, eats grass blocks to regrow wool. Can be sheared for 1-3 wool without killing.
data.notes: Most sheep spawn white. Other natural colors: light gray, gray, brown, black (rare), pink (very rare ~0.164%).

data.name: Pig
data.spawnConditions: Spawns on grass blocks with light level 9+, in groups of 4.
data.behavior: Wanders aimlessly. Can be saddled and ridden, steered with a Carrot on a Stick. Struck by lightning, transforms into a Zombified Piglin.
data.notes: Can also be bred with Potatoes or Beetroot.

data.name: Chicken
data.spawnConditions: Spawns on grass blocks with light level 9+, in groups of 4.
data.behavior: Wanders aimlessly, flaps wings to fall slowly (no fall damage). Lays an egg every 5-10 minutes.
data.notes: Can also be bred with Beetroot Seeds, Melon Seeds, or Pumpkin Seeds. Baby chickens can hatch from thrown eggs (1/8 chance).

data.name: Horse
data.spawnConditions: Spawns on grass blocks in herds of 2-6.
data.behavior: Wanders in herds. Can be tamed, saddled, and fitted with horse armor. Variable stats for speed, jump height, and health (15-30 HP).
data.tamingMethod: Repeatedly mount the horse until hearts appear. Each attempt has a 5% base chance, increasing by 5% each try.
data.notes: Can also be bred with Golden Carrots. 7 base colors and 5 marking patterns create 35 variants. Health ranges from 15-30 HP.

data.name: Donkey
data.spawnConditions: Spawns on grass blocks, rarer than horses, in herds of 1-3.
data.behavior: Similar to horses but slower. Can be equipped with a chest for 15 inventory slots. Cannot wear horse armor.
data.tamingMethod: Repeatedly mount the donkey until hearts appear, same as horses.
data.notes: Breeding a horse with a donkey produces a mule. Can also be bred with Golden Carrots. Health ranges from 15-30 HP.

data.name: Mule
data.spawnConditions: Does not spawn naturally. Bred from a horse and a donkey.
data.behavior: Combines horse and donkey traits. Can carry a chest (15 slots) and be saddled, but cannot wear horse armor.
data.tamingMethod: Repeatedly mount the mule until hearts appear.
data.notes: Mules cannot breed, like in real life. Must be created by breeding a horse with a donkey.

data.name: Rabbit
data.spawnConditions: Spawns on grass or sand blocks with light level 9+, in groups of 2-3.
data.behavior: Hops around, avoids players and predators. Different skin variants depending on biome. Eats carrot crops.
data.notes: Can also be bred with Dandelions or Golden Carrots. The Killer Bunny variant is hostile but unavailable in survival.

data.name: Mooshroom
data.spawnConditions: Only spawns in Mushroom Fields biome on mycelium blocks.
data.behavior: Acts like a cow. Can be milked with a bowl for Mushroom Stew. Shearing removes mushrooms and converts to a regular cow.
data.notes: Red mooshrooms struck by lightning become brown mooshrooms. Brown mooshrooms give Suspicious Stew when milked with a bowl after being fed a flower.

data.name: Squid
data.spawnConditions: Spawns in water between Y=46 and Y=62 in any biome with water.
data.behavior: Swims aimlessly in water, squirts ink cloud when attacked. Takes suffocation damage on land.
data.notes: Ink sacs are used for black dye and crafting books and quills.

data.name: Glow Squid
data.spawnConditions: Spawns in water in complete darkness (light level 0) below Y=30.
data.behavior: Swims aimlessly underwater, emits a glow texture but no actual light. Stops glowing briefly when damaged.
data.notes: Glow Ink Sacs are used to make glowing signs and Glow Item Frames.

data.name: Turtle
data.spawnConditions: Spawns on sand blocks in Beach biomes with light level 8+ above Y=60.
data.behavior: Moves slowly on land, faster in water. Lays eggs on home beach. Baby turtles drop Scute when growing up.
weaknesses: Zombies and Drowned target baby turtles
data.notes: Baby turtles drop a Scute when they grow up. 5 Scutes craft a Turtle Shell helmet providing Water Breathing.

data.name: Fox
data.spawnConditions: Spawns on grass blocks in groups of 2-4. Snow foxes spawn in snowy taiga variants.
data.behavior: Nocturnal, sleeps during the day. Can pick up items in its mouth. Attacks chickens, rabbits, cod, salmon, and baby turtles. Trusts players who bred them.
data.notes: Baby foxes bred by a player will trust the player but still run from others. Can also be bred with Glow Berries.

data.name: Panda
data.spawnConditions: Spawns on grass blocks in Jungle biomes, requires bamboo within 5 blocks.
data.behavior: Eats bamboo and cake. Has 7 personality types: normal, lazy, worried, playful, aggressive, weak, and brown. Aggressive pandas attack when hit.
data.notes: Requires at least 8 bamboo blocks within 5 blocks to breed. Brown pandas are extremely rare (1/64 chance).

data.name: Ocelot
data.spawnConditions: Spawns on grass or leaves in Jungle biomes above Y=63.
data.behavior: Shy, runs from players unless approached slowly while holding raw cod or salmon. Creepers and phantoms avoid ocelots.
data.notes: Since 1.14, ocelots can no longer be tamed into cats but can gain trust. Creepers stay 6 blocks away from ocelots.

data.name: Parrot
data.spawnConditions: Spawns on logs, leaves, or grass in Jungle biomes. Rare.
data.behavior: Flies around, perches on shoulders. Mimics sounds of nearby hostile mobs. Dances when near a playing jukebox.
data.tamingMethod: Feed seeds (wheat, melon, pumpkin, or beetroot seeds). 1/3 chance per seed to tame.
data.notes: 5 color variants: red, blue, green, cyan, gray. Feeding a cookie kills the parrot instantly.

data.name: Bat
data.spawnConditions: Spawns in caves at light level 3 or less, below Y=63. More common in October.
data.behavior: Flies around erratically. Hangs upside down on solid blocks when idle. Completely harmless.
data.notes: Drops no items or XP. Purely ambient mob.

data.name: Cod
data.spawnConditions: Spawns in water in ocean biomes, in groups of 3-6.
data.behavior: Swims in schools. Flops on land and suffocates. Can be picked up with a water bucket.
data.notes: Can be caught with a bucket to create a Bucket of Cod, which can be placed elsewhere.

data.name: Salmon
data.spawnConditions: Spawns in water in cold/frozen ocean and river biomes, in groups of 1-5.
data.behavior: Swims upstream in rivers. Flops on land and suffocates. Can be picked up with a water bucket.
data.notes: Three size variants: small, medium, and large. Used to tame cats.

data.name: Tropical Fish
data.spawnConditions: Spawns in warm/lukewarm ocean water in groups of 8.
data.behavior: Swims in schools of the same variant. Flops on land. Can be picked up with a water bucket.
data.notes: Over 2,700 naturally occurring variants with different colors, patterns, and shapes. 22 unique preset variants.

data.name: Pufferfish
data.spawnConditions: Spawns in warm and lukewarm ocean water.
data.behavior: Inflates when players or mobs approach, dealing poison damage. Three inflation stages: deflated, half-puffed, fully puffed.
data.notes: Inflicts Poison for 7 seconds. Pufferfish are used in Potions of Water Breathing.

data.name: Axolotl
data.spawnConditions: Spawns in water in Lush Caves biome, in total darkness on clay blocks.
data.behavior: Attacks Drowned, Guardians, Elder Guardians, Squid, and Glow Squid. Plays dead when hurt to regenerate health. Grants Regeneration to players who help them fight.
data.notes: 5 color variants: pink (lucy), brown (wild), gold, cyan, and blue (extremely rare, 1/1200 chance).

data.name: Frog
data.spawnConditions: Spawns on grass blocks in swamp biomes.
data.behavior: Jumps high, eats small Slimes and Magma Cubes (producing Froglights from Magma Cubes). Tongue attack with short range.
data.notes: Three variants based on biome temperature where tadpole grows up: temperate (orange), cold (green), warm (white). Each variant produces a different Froglight color.

data.name: Tadpole
data.spawnConditions: Hatches from Frogspawn placed by frogs after breeding. Does not spawn naturally.
data.behavior: Swims in water. Grows into a frog after about 20 minutes. The biome temperature determines the frog variant.
data.notes: Can be picked up with a water bucket. Axolotls will attack and eat tadpoles.

data.name: Camel
data.spawnConditions: One camel spawns in each desert village.
data.behavior: Can carry two players. Has a dash ability. Sits down periodically. Tall enough that most hostile mobs cannot reach riders.
data.notes: Riders sit high enough (over 2 blocks) that zombies, skeletons, and spiders cannot reach them.

data.name: Sniffer
data.spawnConditions: Does not spawn naturally. Hatched from Sniffer Eggs found in Suspicious Sand in Warm Ocean Ruins.
data.behavior: Digs in dirt, grass, and moss blocks to find ancient Torchflower Seeds and Pitcher Pods.
data.notes: Won the 2022 Minecraft Mob Vote. An ancient mob brought back from extinction. Eggs are found through archaeology.

data.name: Armadillo
data.spawnConditions: Spawns on grass blocks in savanna and badlands biomes.
data.behavior: Rolls into a ball when threatened by sprinting players, undead mobs, or spiders. Periodically drops Armadillo Scutes.
data.notes: Won the 2023 Minecraft Mob Vote. Armadillo Scutes are used to craft Wolf Armor.

data.name: Allay
data.spawnConditions: Found in cages in Pillager Outposts and Woodland Mansions. Does not spawn naturally elsewhere.
data.behavior: Collects and delivers items matching what the player gives it. Likes note blocks and will drop items near them. Dances when near a playing jukebox.
data.notes: Can duplicate when given an Amethyst Shard near a note block that was recently played. Extremely useful for item sorting farms.

data.name: Wolf
data.spawnConditions: Spawns on grass blocks in forest and taiga biomes, in packs of 4.
data.behavior: Wild wolves are neutral, attacking only when hit. Tamed wolves follow and protect their owner. Attack skeletons on sight.
data.tamingMethod: Feed bones to a wild wolf. Each bone has a 1/3 chance to tame. Collar appears when tamed.
data.notes: Tamed wolves have 20 HP (10 hearts). When tamed, HP increases and damage is boosted. Can be dyed with any color to change collar color. Wolf Armor was added in 1.20.5.

data.name: Bee
data.spawnConditions: Spawns near bee nests on oak or birch trees. Groups of 3 per nest.
data.behavior: Pollinates flowers and crops (boosting growth). Returns to nest/hive to produce honey. Attacks in swarms if nest is destroyed or bee is hit, loses stinger and dies.
data.notes: After stinging, a bee dies in about 1 minute. Use campfire smoke below nests/hives to harvest honey safely without angering bees.

data.name: Enderman
data.spawnConditions: Spawns at light level 0 in the Overworld. Common in The End. Spawns at any light level in Warped Forest.
data.behavior: Teleports randomly. Becomes hostile when looked at (crosshair on upper body) or attacked. Picks up and moves blocks. Damaged by water and rain.
data.notes: Essential for reaching The End. Ender Pearls craft Eyes of Ender. Wearing a carved pumpkin prevents aggro from eye contact.

data.name: Spider
data.spawnConditions: Spawns at light level 0 in the Overworld on solid blocks. Hostile at night, neutral during the day.
data.behavior: Hostile at night or in darkness, neutral in daylight (unless already aggro). Can climb walls. Fits through 1-block gaps. 1% chance to spawn with a status effect.
data.notes: Can spawn as a Spider Jockey (skeleton rider). Bane of Arthropods deals extra damage to spiders.

data.name: Cave Spider
data.spawnConditions: Spawns from monster spawners in Mineshafts only.
data.behavior: Same as spiders but smaller (1x0.5 blocks) and inflicts Poison on Normal and Hard difficulty. Can fit through 0.5-block gaps.
data.notes: Inflicts Poison for 7 seconds on Normal, 15 seconds on Hard. Found only in Mineshaft spawner rooms with cobwebs.

data.name: Zombified Piglin
data.spawnConditions: Spawns in the Nether in groups. Can also spawn from Nether Portals in the Overworld or when a pig is struck by lightning.
data.behavior: Neutral until one is attacked, then all nearby Zombified Piglins swarm. Always carries a Golden Sword. Immune to fire and lava.
data.notes: Formerly called Zombie Pigman. Hitting one alerts all Zombified Piglins within 35 blocks. They forgive after 20-40 seconds.

data.name: Llama
data.spawnConditions: Spawns on grass blocks in herds of 4-6.
data.behavior: Spits at mobs that attack them or their herd. Can be equipped with chests (3-15 slots based on Strength stat) and carpets as decoration.
data.tamingMethod: Repeatedly mount the llama until hearts appear, similar to horses.
data.notes: Form caravans: leash one llama and up to 9 more will follow in a chain. Spit deals only 1 damage.

data.name: Dolphin
data.spawnConditions: Spawns in groups of 3-5 in non-frozen ocean biomes.
data.behavior: Playful, jumps out of water. Grants Dolphin's Grace speed boost to swimming players. Leads players to treasure if fed raw cod.
data.notes: Dolphins must have access to both air and water or they die. They lead players to the nearest shipwreck or underwater ruins when fed Raw Cod.

data.name: Iron Golem
data.spawnConditions: Spawns naturally in villages with 10+ villagers and 21+ beds. Can be built by players with 4 iron blocks and 1 carved pumpkin.
data.behavior: Defends villagers from hostile mobs. Attacks most hostile mobs on sight. Player-built golems never attack their creator. Village-spawned ones may attack players with low reputation.
data.notes: Can be healed with Iron Ingots. Shows cracks at 75%, 50%, and 25% HP. Immune to knockback and drowning. Offers poppies to villagers.

data.name: Polar Bear
data.spawnConditions: Spawns on ice or snow blocks in cold biomes, in groups of 1-2 (adult sometimes with baby).
data.behavior: Adults are neutral but become hostile if a baby is nearby and a player approaches. Babies are always passive.
data.notes: One of the few mobs that cannot be bred. Adults attack foxes on sight.

data.name: Goat
data.spawnConditions: Spawns on stone, snow, or packed ice in mountain biomes, in groups of 2-3.
data.behavior: Jumps very high (10 blocks). Rams players, mobs, and armor stands every 30-300 seconds. Screaming goats are rare and ram more frequently.
data.notes: Screaming goats are a rare variant (2% chance). Rams can knock off Goat Horns from solid blocks. 8 horn variants exist.

data.name: Trader Llama
data.spawnConditions: Spawns with Wandering Traders. Does not spawn naturally on its own.
data.behavior: Accompanies Wandering Traders, protecting them by spitting at hostile mobs. Becomes tameable after the trader despawns.
data.tamingMethod: Repeatedly mount the llama until hearts appear, after the Wandering Trader has despawned or been killed.
data.notes: Always spawns with a decorative carpet. Can be bred with regular llamas.

data.name: Zombie
data.spawnConditions: Spawns at light level 0 on solid blocks in the Overworld.
data.behavior: Pursues and attacks players and villagers. Burns in sunlight. Can break wooden doors on Hard difficulty. Baby zombies are faster and do not burn.
data.notes: Zombie Villagers have a 5% spawn rate among zombies and can be cured with a Weakness potion and Golden Apple. Can pick up and equip items.

data.name: Skeleton
data.spawnConditions: Spawns at light level 0 on solid blocks in the Overworld.
data.behavior: Ranged attacker with a bow. Burns in sunlight (seeks shade or water). Strafes while shooting. Better accuracy at closer range.
data.notes: Bones are essential for taming wolves and crafting bone meal. Flee from wolves.

data.name: Creeper
data.spawnConditions: Spawns at light level 0 on solid blocks in the Overworld.
data.behavior: Silently approaches players and detonates after a 1.5s fuse. Explosion destroys blocks. Charged creepers (struck by lightning) have double explosion power.
data.notes: Music Discs drop only when killed by a skeleton or stray arrow. Charged creepers kill another mob to drop its head. Iconic Minecraft mob created from a modeling error.

data.name: Witch
data.spawnConditions: Spawns at light level 0 or in Swamp Huts. Villagers struck by lightning become witches.
data.behavior: Attacks by throwing harmful splash potions (Poison, Slowness, Weakness, Harming). Drinks defensive potions (Healing, Fire Resistance, Water Breathing, Speed).
data.notes: Has 85% magic resistance while drinking potions. Witch huts in swamps are the only place they spawn at any light level.

data.name: Slime
data.spawnConditions: In swamps: spawns at light level 7 or less between Y=51-69. In slime chunks: spawns below Y=40 at any light level.
data.behavior: Bounces toward players. Splits into 2-4 smaller slimes when killed (large > medium > small). Only small slimes drop slimeballs.
data.notes: HP values: Large = 16, Medium = 4, Small = 1. Small slimes deal 0 damage. Slime chunks are determined by world seed. Swamp spawning increases during full moons.

data.name: Magma Cube
data.spawnConditions: Spawns anywhere in the Nether. Most common in Basalt Deltas.
data.behavior: Like slimes but immune to fire and lava. Bounces higher and splits when killed. Found in large numbers in Basalt Deltas.
data.notes: HP values: Large = 16, Medium = 4, Small = 1. Frogs can eat small magma cubes to produce Froglights of different colors based on frog variant.

data.name: Phantom
data.spawnConditions: Spawns in the sky at night or during thunderstorms if the player has not slept for 3+ in-game days.
data.behavior: Flies in circles above the player, then swoops down to attack. Burns in sunlight. Targets only players who haven't slept.
data.notes: Phantom Membranes are used to repair Elytra and brew Potions of Slow Falling. Sleep regularly to prevent phantom spawns.

data.name: Drowned
data.spawnConditions: Spawns in ocean and river biomes underwater. Zombies submerged in water for 30 seconds convert to Drowned.
data.behavior: Swims and attacks players in water. Some spawn with tridents (ranged attack). Burns in sunlight on land but safe underwater.
data.notes: Only drowned naturally holding a trident can drop one (8.5% chance on Java). Primary renewable source of tridents and copper.

data.name: Husk
data.spawnConditions: Spawns at light level 0 in desert biomes on sand blocks. Replaces 80% of zombie spawns in deserts.
data.behavior: Zombie variant that does not burn in sunlight. Inflicts Hunger effect on attack. Converts to zombie if submerged in water.
data.notes: Inflicts Hunger effect for 7 seconds multiplied by the regional difficulty. Unlike zombies, husks do not burn in sunlight.

data.name: Stray
data.spawnConditions: Spawns at light level 0 in snowy/frozen biomes. Replaces 80% of skeleton spawns in frozen biomes.
data.behavior: Skeleton variant that shoots Arrows of Slowness. Does not burn in sunlight (unlike regular skeletons).
data.notes: Arrows of Slowness inflict Slowness I for 30 seconds. Strays are immune to freezing damage from powder snow.

data.name: Blaze
data.spawnConditions: Spawns from Blaze spawners in Nether Fortresses.
data.behavior: Flies and shoots triple fireballs. Sets target on fire. Immune to fire and lava. Damaged by snowballs (3 damage each).
data.notes: Blaze Rods are essential for crafting Brewing Stands and Blaze Powder (fuel for brewing and crafting Eyes of Ender).

data.name: Ghast
data.spawnConditions: Spawns in open areas of the Nether with at least 4x4x4 blocks of space.
data.behavior: Large flying mob that shoots explosive fireballs from long range. Fireballs can be deflected back by attacking them.
data.notes: Ghast Tears are used in brewing Potions of Regeneration and crafting End Crystals. Despite their size (4x4x4), they only have 10 HP.

data.name: Wither Skeleton
data.spawnConditions: Spawns in Nether Fortresses at light level 7 or less.
data.behavior: Melee attacker with stone sword that inflicts Wither effect for 10 seconds. Immune to fire. 3 blocks tall, can only spawn in areas with 3+ blocks of headroom.
data.notes: 3 Wither Skeleton Skulls + 4 Soul Sand/Soil are needed to summon the Wither boss. Looting III increases skull drop rate to ~5.5%.

data.name: Piglin Brute
data.spawnConditions: Spawns only in Bastion Remnants during world generation. Does not respawn.
data.behavior: Always hostile to players regardless of gold armor. Extremely strong. Does not barter or retreat. Guards Bastion Remnants.
data.notes: Unlike regular piglins, gold armor does NOT prevent aggro. Transforms into a Zombified Piglin in the Overworld. Does not respawn once killed.

data.name: Piglin
data.spawnConditions: Spawns in the Nether in groups of 2-4.
data.behavior: Hostile unless player wears at least one piece of gold armor. Barters when given Gold Ingots. Hunts Hoglins. Adults attack players who open chests or mine gold.
weaknesses: Becomes Zombified Piglin in the Overworld
data.notes: Bartering with gold ingots gives random items including Ender Pearls, Fire Resistance potions, and more. Transforms into Zombified Piglin in the Overworld or End.

data.name: Hoglin
data.spawnConditions: Spawns in Crimson Forest biomes in the Nether in groups of 3-4.
data.behavior: Aggressive beast that flings players into the air. Fears Warped Fungus and Nether Portals. The only breedable hostile mob.
data.notes: Transforms into a Zoglin in the Overworld. The only breedable hostile mob. Piglins hunt hoglins for food. Repelled by Warped Fungus.

data.name: Zoglin
data.spawnConditions: Does not spawn naturally. Created when a Hoglin enters the Overworld or End.
data.behavior: Undead, zombified Hoglin that attacks almost all mobs and players. Cannot be bred or fed. Extremely aggressive.
data.notes: Attacks all mobs except creepers and other zoglins. Unlike hoglins, zoglins cannot be repelled by warped fungus.

data.name: Ravager
data.spawnConditions: Spawns only during raids (wave 3+). Sometimes ridden by Pillagers, Vindicators, or Evokers.
data.behavior: Charges at players, dealing knockback. Destroys crop blocks and leaves on contact. Roars after being stunned by a shield.
data.notes: Blocking a Ravager charge with a shield stuns it for 2 seconds. One of the strongest non-boss mobs in the game.

data.name: Vex
data.spawnConditions: Summoned by Evokers during combat. Does not spawn naturally.
data.behavior: Tiny flying mob that phases through blocks. Attacks players and villagers. Takes damage over time after 30-119 seconds (starts flickering).
data.notes: Can fly through any block. Allays are the peaceful counterpart of vexes. Summoned in groups of 2-4 by evokers.

data.name: Evoker
data.spawnConditions: Spawns in Woodland Mansions and during raids (wave 5+).
data.behavior: Summons Vexes and casts fang attacks (line of snapping jaws from the ground). Transforms blue sheep into red sheep.
data.notes: Always drops a Totem of Undying, which saves the holder from death once. One of the most valuable mob drops in the game.

data.name: Vindicator
data.spawnConditions: Spawns in Woodland Mansions and during raids (wave 2+).
data.behavior: Aggressive melee attacker wielding an iron axe. Very fast and deals high damage. Named 'Johnny' vindicators attack all mobs.
data.notes: Naming a vindicator 'Johnny' with a name tag causes it to attack all nearby mobs except other illagers and ghasts.

data.name: Pillager
data.spawnConditions: Spawns around Pillager Outposts and during raids (wave 1+).
data.behavior: Ranged attacker using a crossbow. Patrol captains carry Ominous Banners. Killing a captain gives Bad Omen, triggering a raid if you enter a village.
data.notes: Ominous Banner drops only from patrol captains. Patrol groups of 2-5 pillagers roam near villages.

data.name: Guardian
data.spawnConditions: Spawns in and around Ocean Monuments in water.
data.behavior: Shoots laser beams that require charge-up time. Deals thorn damage to attackers. Inflicts Mining Fatigue via Elder Guardians nearby.
data.notes: Laser beam takes 2 seconds to charge. Guardians flop on land and suffocate. Prismarine is used for conduits and sea lanterns.

data.name: Elder Guardian
data.spawnConditions: Exactly 3 spawn per Ocean Monument during world generation. Do not respawn.
data.behavior: Larger guardian variant. Inflicts Mining Fatigue III on nearby players every 60 seconds. Powerful laser attack.
data.notes: Drops Wet Sponge on death. Mining Fatigue III makes mining nearly impossible. 3 Elder Guardians guard each Ocean Monument. Does not respawn.

data.name: Silverfish
data.spawnConditions: Spawns from monster spawners in Stronghold end portal rooms. Hides in Infested Stone variants in mountains and igloo basements.
data.behavior: Small and fast. When attacked, calls nearby silverfish from Infested Stone blocks. Swarms can be overwhelming.
data.notes: Infested Stone blocks look identical to normal stone but break slightly faster and drop no items. Found in Strongholds and mountain biomes.

data.name: Endermite
data.spawnConditions: 5% chance to spawn when an Ender Pearl lands. Despawns after 2 minutes unless named.
data.behavior: Tiny hostile mob that attacks players. Endermen attack endermites on sight, making them useful for Enderman farms.
data.notes: Essential for efficient Enderman XP farms. Name with a name tag to prevent despawning. Endermen prioritize attacking endermites over players.

data.name: Shulker
data.spawnConditions: Spawns in End Cities on purpur blocks during world generation.
data.behavior: Hides in shell-like block, opens to shoot homing projectiles that inflict Levitation for 10 seconds. High armor when closed.
data.notes: Shulker Shells craft Shulker Boxes, the most important storage item in the game. Shulkers can teleport and sometimes duplicate when hit by another shulker's projectile.

data.name: Breeze
data.spawnConditions: Spawns from Trial Spawners in Trial Chambers.
data.behavior: Wind-themed mob that shoots wind charge projectiles. Projectiles deal knockback and interact with certain blocks (buttons, levers, trapdoors). Jumps high to dodge.
data.notes: Breeze Rods craft Wind Charges for players and are used in crafting the Mace weapon and Flow armor trim.

data.name: Bogged
data.spawnConditions: Spawns in swamp biomes and from Trial Spawners in Trial Chambers.
data.behavior: Skeleton variant covered in moss and mushrooms. Shoots Arrows of Poison. Burns in sunlight like regular skeletons.
data.notes: Arrows of Poison inflict Poison I for 4 seconds. Can be sheared for mushrooms. One of the newer skeleton variants.

data.name: Warden
data.spawnConditions: Summoned when Sculk Shriekers are activated 3 times. Does not spawn naturally.
data.behavior: Blind but detects vibrations and smell. Sonic boom ranged attack bypasses armor and shields. Most powerful non-boss mob. Meant to be avoided, not fought.
data.notes: Has 250 hearts (500 HP), more than any boss. Sonic boom attack deals 10 damage regardless of armor. Designed to be avoided, not killed. Drops only 5 XP intentionally.

data.name: Ender Dragon
data.spawnConditions: One Ender Dragon spawns when the player first enters The End. Can be respawned by placing 4 End Crystals on the exit portal.
data.behavior: Flies around the central island, swooping to attack. Healed by End Crystals on obsidian pillars. Breath attack creates lingering damage. Destroys most blocks on contact.
data.notes: Defeating the first dragon drops 12,000 XP (the most in the game). Subsequent kills drop 500 XP. Spawns the exit portal and End Gateway. Dragon Egg appears on first kill only.

data.name: Wither
data.spawnConditions: Built by placing 4 Soul Sand or Soul Soil in a T-shape and placing 3 Wither Skeleton Skulls on top.
data.behavior: Shoots Wither Skulls that inflict Wither effect. Creates massive explosion upon spawning. Second phase (half HP): gains Wither Armor, immune to arrows, charges at players.
data.notes: Nether Star is used to craft a Beacon, one of the most powerful utility blocks. The Wither has 150 hearts (300 HP) and is one of the hardest fights. Destroys all blocks except bedrock, end portal frames, and barriers.

data.name: Cat
data.spawnConditions: Spawns in villages (1 cat per 4 beds, max 10 per village). Black cats also spawn in Swamp Huts.
data.behavior: Stray cats are shy and run from players. Tamed cats follow their owner, sit on command, scare Creepers and Phantoms away, and bring morning gifts.
data.tamingMethod: Slowly approach a stray cat while holding Raw Cod or Raw Salmon. Stay still and let the cat come to you. Each feeding has a 1/3 chance to tame.
data.notes: 11 skin variants. Tamed cats bring morning gifts (string, feathers, phantom membrane, etc.) when the player sleeps. Creepers and Phantoms flee from cats.

data.name: Snow Golem
data.spawnConditions: Does not spawn naturally. Built by placing 2 snow blocks vertically and a carved pumpkin on top.
data.behavior: Throws snowballs at hostile mobs (deals knockback but no damage, except to Blazes). Leaves a snow trail where it walks. Takes damage in hot biomes and rain.
data.notes: Shearing the pumpkin reveals a hidden face underneath. Snowballs deal 3 damage to Blazes. Useful for distracting mobs and creating snow farms.

data.name: Strider
data.spawnConditions: Spawns on lava surfaces in the Nether in groups of 2-4.
data.behavior: Walks on lava. Can be saddled and ridden, steered with a Warped Fungus on a Stick. Shivers and turns purple when outside of lava.
data.notes: The only rideable mob in the Nether. Essential for traversing lava lakes safely. Baby striders sometimes spawn riding an adult.

data.name: Wandering Trader
data.spawnConditions: Randomly spawns near the player with 2 Trader Llamas. Despawns after 40-60 minutes.
data.behavior: Offers random trades for emeralds, selling biome-specific items, flowers, saplings, and other resources. Drinks Invisibility potion at night.
data.notes: Sells items that may be hard to find, like coral, packed ice, or rare saplings. Cannot restock trades. Despawns naturally with leashed llamas staying behind.
